title: Cover remaining hub methods with server routes
objective: ~48 hub methods have full core impls but NO HTTP surface (evolve + satisfaction now done). Wire the next top-priority methods (e.g. fallback chains, remaining feature engines) as routes.
acceptance_criteria: next batch of uncovered hub methods exposed as documented HTTP routes with tests
policy_note: Owner directive 2026-06-13: NO DOWNGRADES. A module that looks like dead code / an old feature is an INCOMPLETE feature to be completed — never removed or gated out. Upgrade only.
resolution: Exposed 4 already-built but HTTP-surfaceless core methods as routes (thin shells, no downgrade): POST /api/v1/prompts/{id}/tokens (count_prompt_tokens), /cost (estimate_prompt_cost), /render (render_prompt), POST /api/v1/input/process (process_input). 4 request DTOs; manual JSON mapping for non-Serialize TokenCount/CostEstimateDetail (no core-API change); Intent serialized directly. Error map mirrors evolve_prompt (bad uuid 400, NotFound 404, Unauthorized 403, ValidationError 422). 8 direct-handler tests (cycle-80 lesson). Gates green both configs; default-build guards hold. Done via worktree feat/hub-methods-server-routes.
